system.description:
You coat your hand in cell manipulating Medical chakra. You can attempt to manipulate the cellular integrity of a creature’s cells.

As an action on your turn, you can touch a willing creature you can reach. When you do, you can jumpstart their cellular regenerative process. The creature regains hit points equal to 5d8 + 12.

Alternatively, as an action you can attempt to touch a hostile creature you can reach. Make a melee ninjutsu attack. On a successful hit, they take 5d10 Necrotic damage and become compromised. A compromised creature must make a constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of their turns for the next minute. Any jutsu or affect that would remove a physical condition can remove the compromised condition on a creature.

A compromised creature who succeeds three saving throws first, ends this condition. A compromised creature has their cells begin to fail and rupture. They suffer a -2 penalty to their AC, attack rolls, and Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence saving throws for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is Cast at A-Rank or higher, the affected creature increases the cost of Jutsu they cast by +2 for the duration as well. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, the penalty to AC, attack rolls and saving throws are increased to -4.
